items.prompt: Technical blueprint schematic style. Clean precise lines on a subtle grid, with deliberate geometric rigor — right angles, parallel rules, measured spacing. Elements are simplified to essential schematic forms — boxes, rounded rectangles, connector lines, anchor dots, callout markers. Color is restrained, near-monochrome with one accent. A faint grid background at very low opacity reinforces the drafting-paper feel. No textures, no shading, no painterly artifacts; the overall feel is engineering-precise, analytical, intentional, like a drawing hung on an engineer's wall. The field is dark blueprint paper in deep navy #0B1F3A with a slightly lighter navy #10284A toward the lower right; all line work, boxes, and anchor dots are drawn in one pale blue line color #9CC3E6 at a crisp uniform 1.5px stroke; a single amber accent #F5A623 marks exactly one highlighted signal path and a few small anchor dots; a faint grid in #9CC3E6 at about 6% opacity covers the whole sheet. Atmospheric drafting composition with no central subject in the left half: keep the left 55% of the canvas calm — only the faint grid and one or two thin horizontal dimension lines — so a native title can sit there. On the right 45%, draw an exploded isometric stack of six identical thin rectangular slabs floating one above another with small vertical dashed alignment lines between them, representing stacked encoder layers; beside the stack, a column of eight small hollow circles (token nodes) connected to a second column of eight circles by a dense fan of thin straight lines, every node to every node, with one amber line brighter than the rest; small right-angle connector lines with tiny arrowheads route from the fan into the bottom slab; a few short dimension brackets with end ticks sit at the stack edges. Everything is flat schematic line work, no perspective shading, no glow blobs. Composed as a 1280×720 full-bleed PPT cover background for hero_page use with the left 55% reserved as a calm SVG title region. NO text of any kind anywhere in the image — no letters, no numbers, no words, no signs, no labels, no captions, no watermarks. Color values (HEX codes like #0B1F3A) and color names are rendering guidance only — do NOT display HEX codes, color names, or palette labels as visible text anywhere in the image.
items.alt_text: Dark blueprint schematic of a stacked Transformer with an all-to-all attention fan between two token columns
